title: 국립중앙도서관과 그 소속 도서관 이용규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text: Article 2 (Scope of Application) These Rules shall apply to the use of library materials under subparagraph 2 of Article 3 of the Libraries Act held by the National Library of Korea and its affiliated libraries (hereinafter referred to as "libraries"), and to the use of library facilities: Provided, That matters concerning the use of certain materials, including special or rare materials, shall be determined by the Director of the National Library of Korea and the directors of its affiliated libraries (hereinafter referred to as "library directors"). <Amended on February 28, 2014; December 8, 2022>
